protocol: One clean seasonal baseline; every detector is fitted on its first 70%. Scenario A scores the clean held-out 30%; B-H are separate unseen datasets. The LSTM calibration holdout is inside the clean training half. Scenario I is an unlabelled CSV: predictions and scores only.

unlabelled_csv.note: Unlabelled inference: predictions and scores only. Precision, recall and F1 are deliberately omitted.
